description: Estimate Portuguese car import tax (ISV, Imposto Sobre Veículos) from the official ISV formula (engine-cc + CO₂ components, with age reduction for used cars). A maintained estimate: it matches the AT (Finanças) simulator to the cent on the common WLTP cases, but is not the official figure and may differ on edge cases (NEDC, light-commercial, month rounding) — confirm the final amount on the official AT simulator. Needs engine displacement (cc), CO₂ (g/km, WLTP), fuel and registration year.

cc.description: Engine displacement in cm³, e.g. 1950 (not needed for heavy goods/buses)

co2.description: CO₂ emissions in g/km (WLTP), e.g. 130 (passenger/motorhome only)

from_eu.description: Registered in an EU member state (true, default). Set FALSE for non-EU imports (Switzerland, UK, USA, Japan…) — non-EU used cars get NO age reduction, so the ISV is the FULL amount (plus customs duty ~10% and VAT 23%, which this tool does not compute).

fuel.description: Fuel: petrol, diesel, hybrid, hybrid_diesel (diesel MHEV/HEV), phev, electric (irrelevant for heavy goods/buses)

peso_bruto.description: Gross weight (kg). REQUIRED for goods vehicles (van_10/commercial_*/pesados_mercadorias): their IUC is weight-based (Cat C/D).

regiao_autonoma.description: Used exclusively in Açores/Madeira → −50% IUC (Cat C/D).

utilizacao.description: Goods use: particular (Cat C, default) or publico/rental (Cat D).

vehicle_type.description: Category (default passenger). Goods van → van_10/commercial_*; heavy goods >3500kg → pesados_mercadorias; bus → pesados_passageiros; motorhome → autocaravana; motorcycle → motorcycle.

name: calculate_isv
